title: geranium aequale
intro: Geranium aequale, commonly known as African geranium or Barberton geranium, is a species of flowering plant in the family Geraniaceae. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its ability to reduce stress and anxiety, promote relaxation, and alleviate symptoms of menopause and menstrual disorders due to its estrogen-like properties. The bioactive constituents of Geranium aequale include geraniol, linalool, and beta-caryophyllene, which contribute to its therapeutic actions of sedation, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic effects. The therapeutic actions of Geranium aequale are attributed to its ability to calm the mind and body, reduce inflammation, and promote a sense of well-being.
